fullName: truck-junction-web-automation:cypress/e2e/ui/PDP/NewTruckPdp.cy.js#PDP - NewTruckPdp [leastPopular] [en] — Eka 3W Cargo TC-NTPDP-01: Get Offers lead opens on launch for Eka 3W Cargo
description:
**Test Case ID:** TC-NTPDP-01
**Title:** Get Offers lead opens on launch for Eka 3W Cargo
**Language:** en

**Description:**
Open the New Truck PDP for Eka 3W Cargo. Confirm the Get Offers lead popup appears on page load with the correct offers title.

**Expected Result:**
User sees “Check Latest Offers on Eka 3W Cargo” with name, mobile, city fields and a Get Offers button.

**Steps:**
1. Open Eka 3W Cargo PDP without dismissing the launch popup
2. Verify Get Offers lead title and fields are visible
